faq.sub_header: Everything you need to know about NeoParlour
faq.a1: NeoParlour is your complete beauty ecosystem designed to bring premium salon discovery, inventory optimization, and direct appointment management into one simple platform.
faq.a2: Listing your basic salon profile and exploring local beauty businesses is completely free. We also offer premium growth tools for inventory and staff optimization.
faq.a3: Both beauty customers looking to book appointments and salon owners managing operations can seamlessly use our unified ecosystem.
faq.q4: How does the appointment system work?
faq.a4: Customers pick a service, preferred date, and localized time window. The appointment updates the salon calendar automatically in real time.
faq.q5: How does inventory management help my salon?
faq.a5: It maps stock levels against actual product consumption during services, alerting you before critical items drop below operational limits.

partner_page.hero_title: Grow Your Salon Business With NeoParlour
partner_page.hero_desc: Get Online Bookings, Manage Customers, Staff, Payments, And Grow Revenue With Our Smart CRM.
partner_page.s1_desc: Sign up on our platform and complete your business profile information.
partner_page.s2_desc: Configure your service list, catalog pricing, and stylist availability timetables.
partner_page.s3_desc: Go live instantly and accept online bookings from local customers 24/7.
partner_page.s4_desc: Track appointments, verify invoice details, monitor staff, and view growth analytics.
partner_page.faq1_a: Simply click on the 'Become a Partner' button, complete the salon registration form with your business and contact details, and our partner support team will guide you through the quick onboarding process.
partner_page.faq2_a: Yes! We provide dedicated setup support to help you configure your service catalog, team timetables, and pricing lists so you can start receiving online bookings immediately.
partner_page.faq3_a: Absolutely. Our platform is built with multi-location management capabilities, enabling you to coordinate and monitor multiple salon branches from a single unified CRM dashboard.
partner_page.faq4_a: Yes, we offer comprehensive training sessions, video tutorials, and documentation guides for you and your staff to ensure you get the absolute most out of our CRM utility features.
partner_page.faq5_a: Yes, we offer dedicated mobile applications for both customer bookings and salon owners/staff members, enabling you to coordinate appointments and manage salon operations on the go.
partner_page.faq6_a: Listing your salon on the NeoParlour search directory is completely free. We offer competitive, transparent subscription tiers for automated marketing campaigns and advanced CRM tools.
